# Alaska Airlines Pull Request

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context. List any dependencies that are required for this change.

## Review Checklist:

- [ ] My update follows the CONTRIBUTING guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own update

## Documentation Checklist:

Fill this in when the PR changes JSDoc, `docs/`, `apiExamples/`, or the README, or upgrades `@aurodesignsystem/auro-cli`. See the [review workflow](https://github.com/AlaskaAirlines/auro-ai/blob/main/docs/usage.md#review-workflow) and the [content guidelines](https://github.com/orgs/AlaskaAirlines/discussions/660).

- [ ] `npm run build` passes, including `auro cem-check --strict`
- [ ] `/auro:doc-review` reports **Converged** in this PR's doc-review ledger
- [ ] Every open question in the ledger is settled: answered, deferred with a ticket, or waived
- [ ] Code bugs found while documenting are filed as tickets and linked here, not fixed in this PR (unless the fix is one line with a test)
- [ ] If this PR upgrades `@aurodesignsystem/auro-cli`, every new `cem-check` finding is fixed here
